channel.title: Waterline Blog
channel.description: Credit, loans and finance in Nigeria and Africa.

item.title: How Loan Apps Use Your Phone Data, and What the Rules Allow in Nigeria
item.description: Nigerian loan apps often request access to contacts, messages and location. Learn what the NDPA 2023 and FCCPC rules permit, and what borrowers should know about data privacy.

item.title: What lenders mean by 'debt-to-income' and how affordability is assessed
item.description: Learn what lenders mean by debt-to-income and how they assess affordability for loans in Nigeria and Africa.

item.title: Loan Tenor Explained: How Length Changes What You Repay
item.description: Loan tenor shapes your monthly payment and total repayment cost. How length affects what you owe, especially in Nigeria's credit market.

item.title: Debt consolidation: what it means to combine several loans into one
item.description: Understand debt consolidation: how combining loans works, benefits, risks, and key considerations.

item.title: Asset Financing in Nigeria: How Equipment and Vehicle Loans Work for SMEs
item.description: How equipment and vehicle loans work in Nigeria: terms, lenders, BOI role, and what SMEs should know before borrowing.

item.title: Understanding Cooperative Societies and Thrift Savings: How Member-Based Borrowing Works
item.description: Learn how cooperative societies and thrift savings groups operate to provide accessible credit and savings options for individuals and SMEs in Africa.

item.title: Guarantors on Nigerian Loans: What the Role Means and Why Lenders Ask for One
item.description: A guarantor on a Nigerian loan helps reduce lender risk. Learn what the role means and why lenders ask for one.

item.title: How Payday Loans and Salary Advances Are Priced and Repaid
item.description: Learn how short-term credit is priced and repaid in Nigeria, including interest, fees, repayment methods, and regulatory protections.

item.title: Buy Now, Pay Later in Nigeria: How Instalment Credit at Checkout Works
item.description: How buy now, pay later instalment credit works at checkout in Nigeria, and what consumers and merchants should know.

item.title: Success‑Fee Debt Recovery Explained: How 'No Recovery, No Fee' Collection Works
item.description: Learn how success‑fee, or 'no recovery, no fee', debt collection works in Nigeria, what the process involves, and the legal rules that govern it.

item.title: WhatsApp Reminders for Unpaid Bills: Effective Practices and Legal Limits in Nigeria
item.description: Learn how Nigerian businesses can use WhatsApp for bill reminders while staying compliant with data protection and consumer protection laws.

item.title: Collecting Arrears and the Nigeria Data Protection Act: Key Compliance Steps for Organisations
item.description: Learn how Nigerian organisations can collect arrears while complying with the NDPA 2023, avoiding harassment and protecting personal data.

item.title: Old arrears: why balances from past terms are still worth following up
item.description: Learn why pursuing old arrears matters for cash flow, compliance and risk management, and how Nigerian laws shape collection practices.

item.title: Instalment Plans for Overdue Fees: How Payment Plans Help People Clear What They Owe
item.description: Learn how instalment plans for overdue fees work, their benefits, and what Nigerian laws say about data protection and fair collection practices.

item.title: How to Collect Unpaid Estate Service Charges Fairly: A Guide for Residents' Associations and Facility Managers
item.description: Learn fair, lawful ways for estates to recover unpaid service charges while respecting data protection and consumer rights.

item.title: How Schools in Nigeria Can Recover Unpaid Fees Without Embarrassing Parents
item.description: Learn respectful, lawful ways for Nigerian schools to collect overdue fees while protecting parents’ dignity and complying with data protection and consumer rules.

item.title: What Happens When a Loan Is Restructured? A Plain-English Walkthrough
item.description: Learn how loan restructuring works, what terms may change, and how it can affect payments, total cost, credit records, and collateral.

item.title: How the CBN’s Monetary Policy Rate Shapes Loan Interest Rates in Nigeria
item.description: Explains how the CBN’s Monetary Policy Rate influences loan pricing, covering transmission channels, lender margins, and regulatory context.

item.title: Collateral vs. Cash‑Flow Lending: How African Lenders Assess Risk
item.description: Learn the differences between collateral‑based and cash‑flow‑based lending in Africa, how each method works, and what factors influence lenders’ choices.

item.title: Understanding Non-Performing Loans (NPLs) and Why the Ratio Matters
item.description: Learn what a non-performing loan is, how it’s calculated, and why the NPL ratio is a key indicator of lending health in Nigeria.
